          }

            .prepare(
              'SELECT version,content_json FROM daily_item_checkpoints WHERE config_id=? AND item_id=?'

            .get(config.id, source.id)
          const old = previous
            ? (JSON.parse(String(previous.content_json)) as Record<string, unknown>)
            : null
          const fields = config.changeFields.filter(
            (field) => !old || old[field] !== current[field]
          )
          const upcoming =
            current.dueAt &&
            !['completed', 'cancelled'].includes(current.status) &&
            Date.parse(current.dueAt) >= Date.parse(period.start) &&
            Date.parse(current.dueAt) <=
              Date.parse(period.start) + config.deadlineWindowHours * 3600000
          if (!fields.length && !upcoming) continue
          checkpoint = {
            itemId: source.id,
            fromVersion: previous ? Number(previous.version) : null,
            toVersion: source.version,
            fields,
            before: old ? JSON.stringify(old).slice(0, 1000) : null,
            after: read.content.slice(0, 1000),
            consumed: false
          }
        }
